meta.description: Ceramic coating, window tint, paint correction and detailing for Macomb Township. Mobile detailing in your driveway, or our shop roughly 30 minutes south.

hero.kicker: Serving Macomb Township, MI: detailing, window tint and ceramic coating
hero.title: North of M-59. **We come to you.**
hero.lede: Our shop on Louise Ave in Clinton Township is about 15 miles from central Macomb Township, roughly 30 minutes without traffic. Detailing can be done in your driveway. Coatings, tint and paint correction happen at the shop, and valet pickup can make the drive for you.

about.title: A township still being built, and what that does to a car.
body: Macomb Township sits in the middle of Macomb County, north of Hall Road, with Shelby Township across Hayes Road to the west and 26 Mile Road along the top. It was flat farmland not long ago. Most of the houses here have gone up since 1990, and building has not stopped. That history decides what lands on your paint and what ends up in your carpet.

points.title: Salt on the main roads, not on your street
points.body: The county clears state and primary roads first. Inside subdivisions it salts only at entrances, exits, intersections and hills. So the salt on your rocker panels comes from the through roads: Hall Road, Romeo Plank and the mile roads. You pick it up on every winter trip out and park it in the driveway.

points.title: Dust while the township fills in
points.body: New houses and road projects mean open dirt. It dries to a fine dust that settles on parked cars and comes in as mud on the first wet day. Wiping that dust off dry is how swirl marks start. It needs a proper wash, not a towel.

points.title: Ball fields, a dog park and the back seat
points.body: Macomb Corners Park has six ball diamonds, eight soccer fields and two sand volleyball courts. Pitchford Park on Romeo Plank has separate large and small dog areas. What comes home from both goes into the back seat and cargo area: infield dirt, sand, grass and dog hair.

points.title: Detached houses, so mobile works
points.body: Most homes in the township are detached houses, and a driveway is all a mobile detail needs: room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle. We bring our own power and water. In a condo or attached home, a parking spot with the same clearance does the job.

logistics.title: Roughly 30 minutes to the shop, or we come up to you.
body: The shop is at 33115 Louise Ave in Clinton Township, about 15 miles from central Macomb Township. From the middle of the township the direct way down is Romeo Plank Road south to Cass Avenue, then Groesbeck Highway (M-97) south to Kelly Road and 14 Mile Road. From the west side, Garfield Road runs straight south to 14 Mile. We are on the north side of 14 Mile, just east of Kelly Road.

Detailing is the part that comes up to you: interior, exterior or the whole vehicle, in your driveway or where you work. Coatings, window film and machine polishing are done indoors at the shop, because they need steady light, clean air and time to cure. If the drive does not fit your day, valet pickup collects the vehicle and brings it back.

faq.q: Do you come out to Macomb Township for mobile detailing?
faq.a: Yes. Macomb Township is in our mobile service area. We bring our own power and water, and we need a driveway or parking spot with room to walk around the whole vehicle. Tell us your nearest mile road when you book so we can plan the trip. See [how mobile and valet work](/mobile-detailing/).

faq.q: How far is your shop from Macomb Township?
faq.a: About 15 miles from central Macomb Township, roughly 30 minutes without traffic. Romeo Plank backs up southbound on busy days, so leave a cushion at rush hour. The address is 33115 Louise Ave, Clinton Township. Look for Louise Ave on the north side of 14 Mile, just east of Kelly Road. We are appointment only, so book before you head down.

faq.q: Can you coat or tint my vehicle in my driveway?
faq.a: No. A coating or a sheet of film laid outdoors picks up whatever is in the air, and around new construction that is dust. Both jobs are done indoors at the shop. Valet pickup covers the trip if you cannot, and for [ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating-macomb-township-mi/) your Uber is covered while the vehicle is with us.

faq.q: What does a detail cost for an SUV or a truck?
faq.a: For a coupe or sedan in average condition, interior details are from $184.99, exterior details from $139.99 and full inside and out details from $249.99. A three row SUV or a crew cab truck has more to clean, so it is quoted for its size before we start. See [detailing in Macomb Township](/car-detailing-macomb-township-mi/).

faq.q: Do you tint windows for Macomb Township drivers?
faq.a: Yes, at the shop. We install Geoshield C2 Carbon and C2 Ceramic film, computer cut for your vehicle. Front two windows are from $99.99 in carbon on a standard coupe or sedan and take about 1.5 hours. Most installs are finished the day you drop off. See [window tint for Macomb Township](/window-tint-macomb-township-mi/).
